protocol.primaryMetric: MAE across 10 origins × 6 horizons, equally weighted
protocol.selection: Choose simplest model in listed order within 1% of minimum development MAE.
protocol.furtherWork: Exploratory only: selected development MAE at least 10% below last-value, strictly better at >=6/10 origins, and holdout MAE no worse than last-value. These are prespecified heuristics, not business acceptance or significance tests.

scope.population: Distinct active employees present at month end; hire_date <= snapshot_date and termination_date absent or > snapshot_date

limitations: Overlapping origins are correlated; 60 forecast errors are not 60 independent samples.
Only 12–21 training months at development origins; annual seasonality has limited support.
No cost, subgroup, interval or operational forecast.
